# Mission Decomposition
Translate MISSION and GOAL into atomic mandatory requirements, scope, exclusions, dependencies, blast radius, negative-path obligations, evidence grades and definition of done. Separate owner decisions from engineering decisions. Unknown technical facts trigger investigation, not user interruption. Maintain a requirement ledger so broad missions cannot finish with unvisited requirements.
